<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Purple Rat 85</title>
<style>
/* Purple Rat 85 by satyamchaudharydev — https://uiverse.io/satyamchaudharydev/purple-rat-85 */
button {
  --bg: #e74c3c;
  --text-color: #fff;
  position: relative;
  width: 150px;
  border: none;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text-color);
  padding: 1em;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition: 0.2s;
  border-radius: 5px;
  opacity: 0.8;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  box-shadow: #c0392b 0px 7px 2px, #000 0px 8px 5px;
}

button:hover {
  opacity: 1;
}

button:active {
  top: 4px;
  box-shadow: #c0392b 0px 3px 2px,#000 0px 3px 5px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Click me
</button>

</body>
</html>
